m: वषट् ind. (accord. to some fr. √ 1. वह्; cf. 2. वट् and वौषट्) an exclamation uttered by the Hotṛ priest at the end of the sacrificial verse (on hearing which the Adhvaryu priest casts the oblation offered to the deity into the fire; it is joined with a dat., e.g. पूष्णे वषट्; with √ कृ, ‘to utter the exclamation वषट्’), RV.; VS.; Br.; ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh.; Pur.
a: वषट् — ind. An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity, (with dat. of the deity); इंद्राय वषट्, पूष्णे वषट् &c. --Comp. --कर्तृं m. the priest who makes the oblation with the exclamation वषट्. --कारः the formula or exclamation वषट्.

k.v: स्वाहा हा देवहविर्दाने श्रौषट्वौषट्वषट्स्वधा। किञ्चिदीषन्मनागल्पे प्रेत्यामुत्र भवान्तरे॥
